newsitem.title: USA: Check Technology completes sale in China.
newsitem.headline: Check Technology completes sale in China.

text.p: Check Technology Corp said Tuesday it completed a sale of its check printing equipment to Beijing Banknote Printing Co, a subsidiary of the state-owned China Banknote Printing and Minting Co.
The value of the sale was not disclosed.
Beijing Banknote Printing will begin producing with the new equipment encoded checks for Beijing and other commercial centers including Tianjin, Dalian, and Shenyang.

China recently installed an automated check clearing system which requires that all checks bear machine-readable encoding for processing. Check Technology's automated equipment provides this encoding.
Check Technology makes and markets print production systems for financial and forms printers worldwide.
